title: 2026 F-gas foam aerosol and fire-protection product-ban QA

sources.title: Bans on F gas in new products and equipment: current and future
Fluorinated gas (F gas): guidance for users, producers and traders

facts.source_fact: One-component foam aerosols using F gases above GWP 150 are banned.
HFCs at the stated GWP threshold are banned in extruded polystyrene foam.
HFCs at the stated threshold are banned in other foams including polyurethane, subject to national-safety-standard exception.
Novelty aerosols and signal horns using HFCs above GWP 150 are banned.
Technical aerosols above GWP 150 are banned subject to safety-standard and medical-application exceptions.
PFCs are banned in all fire protection systems.
HFC23 is banned in all fire protection systems.
The same guidance also lists magnesium smelting and other specific F-gas uses separately.
facts.expected_handling: Do not merge unrelated ban categories.

facts.source_fact: Ban status is based on gas, GWP, use and exception predicates.
Product-ban status is not a parcel emissions value.
